name: AINave

sources.title: Homepage — 'The OS for AI builders', product discovery + tech news
Pricing — Free $0 tier (public listing, do-follow backlink) and Verified $5 one-time
Product Submission Guidelines — acceptance criteria and review process

requirements: Functional software product, actively built — MVPs and active-beta products OK if core functionality is live
Rejected: courses/ebooks, physical products, non-functional demos, services/agencies without a software product, NSFW, clones without differentiation
Must meet a reasonable quality bar — no critical bugs, usable UI; dev tools need docs/README; mobile apps need a live store listing or functional web version
Pricing model must be stated honestly — 'free' must have a genuinely free tier
Submitter must own the product or be authorized to list it
Must provide a support contact path
preparation: Clear description: what it does, who it's for, why it matters
Screenshots, demo video, or live preview (strongly encouraged)
Pricing model, Terms/Privacy links if the product collects user data
workflow: Sign up / log in on ainave.com
Go to /dashboard/products/submit and fill the submission form
Review is claimed to be 'almost instant' — if still pending after 30 minutes email ramit@ainave.com
Free tier gives public listing + community discovery; optional $5 one-time Verified adds verified badge, do-follow backlink, higher visibility, future Launchpad eligibility
watchFor: Pricing page lists 'Verified badge' and 'Do-follow backlink' under BOTH the Free tier and the $5 Verified tier — the badge/backlink difference between tiers is ambiguous
Payment handled by Dodo Payments for the $5 tier
Products found by the team's own scouting may already be listed — claim via ramit@ainave.com from a company email
Review 'almost instantly' likely means automated/low-friction — the listing may publish fast; ensure details are right before submitting
Solo-maintainer site (built by Ramit) — durability depends on one operator
countsAsLive: The product has a public /products/<slug> page on ainave.com and appears in /products browse or category/tag feeds
unknowns: Exact form fields behind the dashboard login
Whether the free-tier backlink is actually do-follow (both tiers claim it)
